title: How an LLM Picks the Next Word
description:
A language model scores every possible next token, turns the scores into probabilities, samples one, and temperature decides how adventurous that pick is.

The probabilities shown are illustrative, not from a real model. Inspired by the strict-structure prompts of @verbove, @twoclipping and @__morse and by @emollick (yihui-dev/awesome-opus5-5-videos). Narration is a synthetic voice (VoiceStudio). Animation is written as code.
